title: Oily Spicy Jamaican Chicken Breast Curry
description: A spicy and silky Jamaican chicken breast curry made with shio-cure and cooked in a copper pot, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Preheat the copper pot over medium heat.
Rub the chicken breast with shio cure and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Add coconut oil to the copper pot and saute the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the diced scotch bonnet peppers and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast to the copper pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chicken broth and heavy cream to the copper pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
